source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Versioned, provenance-tagged corpus of verified quotations served over typed APIs; exported in the ITU InputDocs format
evidence: every chunk carries source, section, page, jurisdiction, claim class and verification class
limitations: A curated corpus of quotations, not a marketplace; no data or model exchange with other parties.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Agent outputs are typed judgments with probabilities, recorded and replayable, never free text that could be republished as policy
evidence: recorded answers under evaluation/agent_runs replay exactly
limitations: No content is generated for distribution; the dimension applies only to how model output is recorded.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Health and telecom evidence are read side by side: the Policy Evidence Analyst (DHA lens) and the conditional institutional analyst (TDRA lens); conflicts detected in code
evidence: TELECOM_GAP and READINGS_DIFFER conflicts in the audit chain
limitations: Two domains (health, telecom); financial, insurance and civil-registry data are out of scope.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Jurisdiction is a first-class input: Dubai, federal and other-emirate layers; comparators (UK, US, EU, Saudi) can inform but never bind; Arabic queries map to the English clauses
evidence: applicability filter and ARABIC_GLOSSARY in the retriever
limitations: Verified quotations are English; the Arabic texts could not be extracted reliably, so no Arabic quotation is stored.

framework_dimension: 5 Level of Integration of AI in Workflows
source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: The council deliberates at every decision point of the case workflow; a corroborated finding opens a real escalation
evidence: agent.message, assurance.review and orchestrator.decision entries per step
limitations: Simulated laboratory and transport; no integration with a real LIS, EHR or SMS gateway.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Supervisor queue, React console, decision trace and audit view; escalations carry an owner and a deadline and are re-escalated when overdue
limitations: No authentication by default (optional API key); English-only interface; not usability-tested.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Design follows the UAE AI Charter (human oversight) and the DHA AI policy PP-09 (override, traceable failures)
evidence: clauses cited in the README and report
limitations: The UAE National Strategy for AI 2031 is not in the KB: the official PDF was not retrievable by script.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Analysts propose, an adversarial reviewer on a different model family challenges, deterministic assurance checks; a person decides on escalation
evidence: reviews with CORRECTED / UPHELD / DISPUTED outcomes
limitations: Hosted models (Mistral, Jev) are used for synthetic cases only; the local 14B reference model has not been run end to end.

framework_dimension: 9 Impacts of Humans in AI Integration
source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: The gate decides every transition without reading model output; agents may only add an escalation; human override recorded
evidence: orchestrator.decision and escalation entries in the hash chain
limitations: Independent validation, which DHA PP-09 §4.3.3 requires before deployment, has not been done.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Health-data residency enforced before any model call (Law 2/2019 Art. 13); MR 51/2021 exceptions routed to a person; 18-entry policy gap register with global comparators
evidence: REFUSED_RESIDENCY for a real case on an offshore endpoint
limitations: Residency is decided from the endpoint name unless resolved addresses are supplied; network egress is not observed.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Arabic questions reach the right clause; acknowledgment requires the person, not the handset; a reply from someone else is caught
limitations: No Arabic user interface; no accessibility testing; synthetic patients only.

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Per-case priority by scope (walk-in vs genetic), configured acknowledgment window and escalation tiers
evidence: acknowledgment_clock_minutes and escalation_response_minutes in the profile
limitations: Clocks are institutional settings, not statutory values: no instrument sets them (gap GR-03).

source_reference: ITUAIReadiness simulation/data/framework/dimensions.json (13 dimensions); ITU AI Readiness Report 2.0 (F2)
implemented_capability: Single-container build; vector KB built with the ITU reference ingest (ChromaDB + Ollama nomic-embed-text); hybrid retrieval
evidence: Dockerfile at the repository root; kb/chroma built locally
limitations: The ChromaDB store is built locally, not shipped; default retrieval is BM25 unless RESULTRELAY_RETRIEVAL=hybrid.
